findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This removes the function’s tenant-isolation check and permits cross-tenant document access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access unconditionally. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` can read another tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Reinstate tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any other tenant whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, completely bypassing the function’s tenant-isolation boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
